messages.subject: ggplot2 solution replacing Venn diagram?
parts:
Hello,

I would appreciate any ideas and pointers on (ggplot2-mediated) graphical display of membership overlaps between (multiple) destinct groups?

Thanks for any nudges.

Sincerely, Joh

messages.author: 82a48e4f7a0db6a3
messages.subject: Re: ggplot2 solution replacing Venn diagram?
parts:
Joh,

I would create a new indicator variable.  0 if in neither, 1 if in group 1, 2 if in group 2, 3 if in both, then color/shape/size by that indicator variable.

-Ilya

>
> I would appreciate any ideas and pointers on (ggplot2-mediated) graphical display of membership overlaps between (multiple) destinct groups?

It's difficult to see exactly what you want without an example. To recreate a Venn diagram I would use large dots at arbitrary coordinates with transparent (alpha aesthetic) colors so that the overlaps show as darker regions.
